text:
Maya: quick UX check — compact scorecard: when the action strip becomes sticky its being removed from tab order. Repro: open a long diff, scroll, press Tab.

Devon: saw that. Figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-scorecard-actions. My take: keep the strip in DOM after the list so DOM order matches visual order. Use CSS to pin it, don't move it in DOM.

Priya: copy nudge: button should read 'Approve visible results' not just 'Approve'. Include count if known. Confirm modal should show exact number and 'You can revert this from regression history.'

Sam: accessibility checklist: 1) action strip should be role="region" aria-label="Eval actions"; 2) announce appearance with aria-live="polite" ("Actions available: Approve visible results, Re-run"); 3) do not steal focus when it appears; focus only when user triggers via keyboard shortcut. Example snippet in PR description.

QA Bot: e2e failing: /e2e/prompt-evals/action-strip-focus.spec.js — test asserts listContainer.nextElementSibling.id === 'action-strip' but current impl injects strip at top. Failing on Chrome and Safari.

Maya: proposal: render strip after list in DOM, absolutely position to bottom:0, add a skip link at top 'Skip to actions (press Shift+.)' for keyboard discoverability. Also add low-contrast divider and small shadow so users know it's separate.

Devon: agree. For shortcuts let's pick Shift+. (period) to avoid common browser conflicts. Add help dialog with shortcuts for screen readers.

Priya: microcopy: main CTA 'Approve 8 visible results', confirm title 'Approve visible results?', body 'Approving will mark these results as expected for this prompt set. You can revert this from regression history.' Primary CTA 'Approve 8 results' secondary 'View changes' cancel 'Cancel'.

Sam: implementation note: keep strip in DOM but off-screen with aria-hidden="true" until visible. When showing remove aria-hidden and set aria-live message. If user presses shortcut focus the first button in the strip. Ensure buttons have explicit aria-labels with counts.

QA Bot: please update e2e to check DOM order and tab sequence. Current flaky test should be stable if strip is placed after list.

Maya: action items: Devon to update Figma, Sam to add aria snippets in PR, Priya to finalize copy strings (i18n keys), QA to add/adjust e2e. Sync Thurs 11am to sign off. Thanks! :thumbsup:
